Lina (Finance): Heads-up: two customers reported unusual embed billing this week after upgrading to the ZapWorks connector. Both say the SDK version was the only change. Can integrations confirm if our ingestion saw duplicates? /cc @Jorge @Nina
Sam (Billing Ops): We have invoice IDs ready to audit if it's on our side. Want a quick before/after aggregate to share with customers.
Jorge (Integrations): I can pull raw events. ZapWorks rolled connector v2.1.4 on 2026-04-10 which changed batch ACK handling. Potential duplicate ACK -> client retry loop.
Nina (Eng-ML): Running a search for dedup keys and batch ids for the affected tenant ids.
Nina (Eng-ML): ```
SELECT batch_id, customer_id, COUNT(*) as events, SUM(embed_units) as total_units
FROM ingestion.raw_events
WHERE connector='zapworks' AND event_time >= '2026-04-09' AND event_time <= '2026-04-12'
GROUP BY batch_id, customer_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY total_units DESC
LIMIT 5;
```
Jorge (Integrations): Results show ~4,200 duplicated batches across two customers (customer_a, customer_b). Duplicates are same batch_id with identical payload_id; timestamps differ by <2s.
Sam (Billing Ops): Can we map duplicates to billed embed units? We need delta units attributable to duplicates and a dollar amount.
Nina (Eng-ML): Quick rollup: customer_a raw billed_units=2,180,000 for Apr window. Duplicates accounted for ~980,000 units (estimated) -> duplicate delta 980k. customer_b billed_units=1,050,000 with duplicate delta ~220k.
Lina (Finance): What rate do we use for connector customers? Both are on mid-market embed rate $0.00036/unit.
Sam (Billing Ops): Calc: customer_a refund = 980,000 * 0.00036 = $352.80. customer_b refund = 220,000 * 0.00036 = $79.20. Round to nearest $10? Need approval for the policy.
Eli (Customer Success): Both customers are sensitive. Recommend rounding up to $360 and $80 respectively and offering a short note explaining the cause and steps taken.
Jorge (Integrations): Root cause: ZapWorks v2.1.4 incorrectly signals "ack" before persisting ack-state server-side. Clients retry on missing server-side ack, causing duplicate payload replays. We rolled a server-side tolerant de-dup layer yesterday but need a retro fix with ZapWorks.
Nina (Eng-ML): I'll add a backfill-safe de-dup in metering: mark event_id as idempotent and ignore exact duplicates for billing during the Apr window if batch_id matches and payload hash identical. Need Finance sign-off to ignore duplicate units in the billing ledger.
Lina (Finance): Approve ignoring duplicates for billing ledger for invoices covering 2026-04-09..2026-04-12 for the two affected customers. Approve the rounded credits: $360 and $80. Please include a short audit entry referencing this thread.
Sam (Billing Ops): Will apply credits and include CSV evidence for both customers. Billing Bot: credit_queued customer=customer_a invoice=2026-04 amount=$360 ref=ZW-CR-1967890123 status=queued
Billing Bot: credit_queued customer=customer_b invoice=2026-04 amount=$80 ref=ZW-CR-1967890123 status=queued
Eli (Customer Success): I'll send the messages: short apology, explanation that duplicate deliveries from a third-party connector caused the extra units, we've issued credits, and next steps with ZapWorks.
Jorge (Integrations): Raised INT-1109 with ZapWorks and copied legal/partner-eng. Also adding a retro tag to the connector repo to ensure client-side retry behavior is hardened.
Nina (Eng-ML): I'll run a sweep across all connectors to detect similar duplicate spikes and post results in #eng-ml tomorrow.
Lina (Finance): Thanks all. Please attach the CSVs and the INT ticket to the invoice notes so audit has trail.
Sam (Billing Ops): Will do and mark invoices as adjusted.
